lead_raw_text:
The structure of ZnCdBr₃ crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 20 atoms and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cd centers in octahedral environments with six Br neighbors at 2.82 Å, while Zn centers also have six Br neighbors at 2.61 Å. The same analysis identifies corner-sharing between Cd octahedra and Zn six-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Cd octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
